arbor.companyDescription: Arbor Lodging (CALA) is the Caribbean & Latin America practice of Arbor Lodging—a vertically integrated hotel investment and management company. From a fully operational Mexico City base, we combine local presence with U.S. platform depth across business development, operations, sales, revenue management, marketing, finance, accounting, HR, and communications. We are an approved third-party operator for Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG, with growing third-party management momentum in Mexico and the broader CALA region.
arbor.brand_narrative_compliance: We balance brand standards with owner economics: proactive QA readiness, PIP execution, and joint decisions with ownership when renovation or revenue trade-offs arise—supported by experience implementing brand capital improvement guidelines across major flags.
arbor.overview_signal_2_value: 12 CALA countries — team representative experience (Experiencia Regional, Jun 2026)
arbor.sustainabilityPrograms: No quantified sustainability program framework is specified in the ALM overview; initiatives are property and brand dependent.
arbor.emergencyResponse: Crisis response is coordinated through local property teams and regional leadership with direct senior involvement.
arbor.companyHistory: Arbor Lodging was founded in 2006 and built in Chicago by Vamsi Bonthala and Sheenal Patel into a vertically integrated owner-operator and manager. The company operates Arbor Lodging Partners (investment) and Arbor Lodging Management (operations), with Arbor Management Solutions providing outsourced accounting and commercial support to other management companies. CALA expansion has been deliberate: a fully operational Mexico City office integrated with U.S. operations for three+ years, relationship-building across the region, and Christian Hutchinson appointed Director of Business Development, CALA, in November 2025. This CALA profile does not represent a current managed-hotel footprint in the region.

It combines local leadership and regional operating support with Hotel Equities' broader management platform. The division is positioned around all-inclusive resorts and urban/lifestyle hotels.

he.companyHistory:
Founded in 1989 by Fred "Coach" Cerrone, Hotel Equities was built on a foundation of operational excellence and a people-centered culture.
A major milestone occurred in 2016 when the company expanded internationally into the Canadian market, successfully establishing an in-market corporate team and growing that portfolio to over 40 properties.
Building on this proven international expansion model, Hotel Equities formed a strategic partnership with Trust Hospitality in 2024 to launch and rapidly scale its dedicated Caribbean and Latin America (CALA) division.

ghl.companyDescription: GHL Hoteles is a Latin American hospitality operator that manages a multi-brand portfolio spanning proprietary GHL brands and international affiliations. The company supports owners and investors with end-to-end hotel operations—commercial, revenue, F&B, and property-level execution—across diverse markets in Central America, the Andean region, and the Southern Cone. GHL emphasizes scalable operating processes, brand-standard coordination, and locally relevant guest experiences while maintaining portfolio discipline across urban, resort, and mixed-demand environments.
ghl.companyHistory: Founded in 1964 (origins traced to Popayán, Colombia), GHL Hoteles grew from Colombian roots into a regional operator with a footprint across Latin America. Over decades the group expanded through both proprietary brand development and partnerships with international chains, building a platform capable of operating multiple chain scales and product types in parallel. Today the company markets a broad portfolio under GHL-owned brands (e.g., GHL Collection, GHL Relax, GHL Style) alongside franchised and affiliated international brands, reflecting a strategy that combines brand breadth with local execution capability.
